source.operation: offline response parsing plus read-only queries, selected set/readback/restore checks, RUN/STOP/SINGle transitions, one acquisition-memory waveform, and one raw screen-image block
source.transport: USB CDC-ACM (VID:PID 2184:0014), /dev/ttyACM1, 115200 8N1; no *RST, *SAV, *RCL, autoscale, calibration, file write, or hardcopy START was sent

manual.title: GDS-2000A Series Programming Manual
manual.location: local converted text ref/GDS-2000A_Programming_Manual_v1.4.extracted.md; the converted copy has no body page breaks, so page citations are table-of-contents or List of Commands markers (pp. 24-34), never inferred body pages

data.raw_provenance: Real :ACQuire1:MEMory? response after :STOP, captured on 2026-11-26 from GDS-2104A serial GEN182193, firmware V1.18, over USB CDC-ACM 2184:0014 at /dev/ttyACM1. The block contains an ASCII header, 'Waveform Data;', '#510000', 10,000 payload bytes (5,000 signed 16-bit points), and one LF. The full exchange is in artifacts/hw-verify/gds2000a-20261126/ (git-ignored, local reference only). This is a code-domain capture, not a calibrated voltage record.

support.hardware_verified_scope: Restricted to the observations captured on 2026-11-26 from GDS-2104A serial GEN182193, firmware V1.18, USB CDC-ACM 2184:0014 at /dev/ttyACM1: *IDN? identity; the :SYSTem:ERRor? format and its +0 record; read-only queries for acquisition mode/record length/header, CH1 vertical settings, math display/type, hardcopy state, measurement gating/method, timebase, trigger, panel lock, save-image format/ink saver, search state/total, buzzer, Go-NoGo script state, and segment state/total; set/readback/restore of :CHANnel1:SCALe, :CHANnel1:COUPling, :TIMebase:SCALe, :TRIGger:LEVel, and :BUZZER; :MEASure:SOURce1 change/restore and :MEASure:PK2PK? including Ch Off; :RUN/:STOP/:SINGle transitions; one :ACQuire1:MEMory? 5,000-point CH1 waveform; and one raw :DISPlay:OUTPut? block. Every other command family remains documented, and no waveform voltage calibration or image decode is claimed.
known_limitations: Hardware evidence covers one unit, firmware, and interface; do not extend it to another GDS-2000A model, firmware revision, or transport.
The programming manual gives no code-to-volts formula. Waveform calibration is UNVERIFIED and analysis_allowed is code-domain-only.
The 16-bit RGB run-length screen image is captured raw; no decoder is bundled, so image content is UNVERIFIED.
No :SAVe:* file write and no :HARDcopy:START write was performed; file existence and content are unverified.
Only one :ACQuire1:MEMory? waveform (5,000 points) is shipped; the 1,000,000-point :ACQuire1:LMEMory? capture in local evidence is not shipped.
Only CH1 was exercised for vertical and measurement reads; CH2-CH4 behavior is unverified.
Most trigger subtypes, slotted-measurement configuration, math/FFT configuration, cursors, reference waveforms, and the remaining individual measurement items were not exercised.
Ethernet (DS2-LAN), GPIB (DS2-GPIB), RS-232C, the DS2-FGN function generator, DS2-8LA/16LA logic/bus options, DVM, Datalog, and Go-NoGo execution were not exercised.
Optional-option queries returned -240, empty lines, or -221 on the verified unit; treat every optional feature as absent until confirmed.
USB CDC serial defaults are not stated by the manual; 115200 8N1 is the helper default and the verified host setting, not a device requirement.
The manual's List of Commands often omits query '?' and channel/slot suffixes; the hardware required suffixed query forms. See references/command-reference.md.
The local command list omits the Go_NoGo/Template block (TOC pp. 226-231); those forms are recorded in Appendix A and are not part of the 339-row denominator.
The manual documents trigger states with a leading '*'; V1.18 returned them without it. The manual documents 'Chan Off'; V1.18 returned 'Ch Off'.
:TIMebase:EXPand? is documented for V1.18 but returned -221 Settings conflict on the verified unit.
:TRIGger:FREQuency? returned a second LF; the parser keeps it as framing evidence, not as a second response.
